data.narrative:
Defense Unicorns, founded by Rob Slaughter, Jeff McCoy, and Andrew Greene, is a Series B-stage defense and security company currently valued at $1.0B post-money following $171M in total capital raised. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 companies (2 public, 8 private) operating in the Defense & Security sector at similar stages, including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Heven AeroTech.

Two quantitative methods were applied. The stage-progression approach, anchoring to the $1.0B last post-money valuation and applying a typical 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $1.9B. The peer-median method examines six same-sector, same-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.1B (range: $300M–$3.0B), yielding an implied value of $1.1B. Triangulating these two methods produces a low estimate of $956M, a median of $1.5B, and a high of $2.2B.

The analysis supports a valuation range of approximately $1.5B–$2.2B, with $1.5B representing the median across methods. Key uncertainties include variance in peer growth rates and profitability timelines within the defense sector, as well as the wide range observed in the peer set ($300M–$3.0B), which reflects differentiation in technology maturity and customer concentration.
